job.title: Senior Android Engineer, App Experience & Frameworks
job.pay_full: $196,000 – $227,000 USD base pay range; may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits

details.about: Airbnb's App Experience & Frameworks team gives product teams the feature foundations and app-wide frameworks they need to build high-quality experiences. It sits in the App Foundation organization, which handles company-wide priorities such as performance, event logging and app configuration, and builds app-wide features like the Host Task System, navigation and the Early Access Program. The Senior Android Engineer drives new guest and host features from prototype to production launch.
duties: Build features and frameworks that improve the app for millions of guests and hosts, such as app navigation, announcement scheduling and frameworks behind host required actions
Work with Design and Product to ideate, prototype, develop and ship product features and app-wide frameworks
Prototype to test ideas while thinking about long-term technical design and architecture
Turn prototypes into high-quality, scalable, maintainable production code
Partner with other engineering teams to integrate features, and improve the team's frameworks from developer feedback
Troubleshoot and fix bugs, accessibility and globalization issues in the Android app
needs: 5+ years building production Android applications at scale
Expertise in Kotlin or Java and Jetpack Compose, with a deep understanding of client architecture and UI performance
Experience working with backend, iOS and web engineers to integrate APIs and keep cross-platform experiences consistent
Bias to action in ambiguous situations and the ability to lead projects end to end
Strong cross-functional partnership, flexibility when scope or priorities change, and a high bar for polish, accessibility and quality
nice: Experience shipping user experiences with fluid interactions, motion and graphics
details.benefits: Base pay range $196,000 – $227,000 USD; actual base pay depends on training, skills, experience, business needs and market demands, and the range may change. The role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits.
notes: US remote-eligible: you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity (Airbnb publishes a list of excluded states)
May include occasional work at an Airbnb office or offsites, as agreed with your manager
Airbnb recruiters only email from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com and never ask candidates for money
